name: Trivia
description: Take turns answering multiple-choice questions. Harder questions are worth more points.
summary: Each player takes turns answering a question with four options. Easy questions are worth 1 point, medium 2, and hard 3. After everyone has had three questions, the highest score wins. Questions come from the Open Trivia Database (CC BY-SA 4.0), with a built-in backup set. The correct answer stays on the server until it has been answered.
